extraction_instructions: TYPO3 landing page /congress2027. Congress dates (12-15 June 2027) only appear in the meta description; the body lists session dates first (13 June), so a synthetic header line from og:description is used. Place from 'takes place at <Venue>, <City>, <Country>'. Fees on /congress2027/register/registration (table, EUR, early/regular/late/virtual per category). Abstract key dates on /abstracts/public-submission-instructions.

Custom ASP.NET microsite; header lines give 'July 18-21, 2027 | Chicago, United States, and Online'; the title line carries the organiser, not a place. Venue (McCormick Place) from the 'Conference Location' block. Abstract dates: /abstracts/overview.asp Important Dates table is Date | Event; <tr> cells are read directly. General abstract deadline 11 Jan 2027 (ISTAART deadline 18 Jan is a different row); submission opening is 'Mid November 2026' (vague, so abstract_open false, no date invented).

Cold Fusion site, www.auanet.org/AUA2027. No dated body line: the only date is the meta description ('May 21 - 24, 2027 in San Diego,CA'). Nav links are relative to /AUA2027/ but the URL has no trailing slash, so sub-pages are given explicitly (key-dates). Registration opens 2 Dec 2026; no fees yet. Site notice forbids feeding AUA content to AI tools, so description is a deterministic meta sentence and no LLM call is made.

aao.org/annual-meeting is the finished AAO 2026 page. The next edition is listed on /annual-meeting/past-and-future-meetings under 'Future Meetings' as three lines: 'AAO 2027' / 'Las Vegas, Venetian Expo & Hotel' / 'Nov. 12-15: AAO 2027'. Bespoke edition parser; no fees or abstracts published yet.

Sitecore site. Annual-meeting page header 'Annual Meeting: Nov. 29 - Dec. 3, 2026'; place from the pricing page (McCormick Place, Chicago). Pricing page /annual-meeting/attendee-resources/pricing-and-registration has three matrices (member packages as text, select member categories and non-member registrant types as HTML tables) parsed from raw <table> cells.

CHEST event page shows the current edition as year-less header lines ('October 18 to 21 | CHEST Annual Meeting', 'CHEST 2026') and a 'save the dates' list ('2027: October 24-27 | Vancouver, BC, Canada'). Bespoke edition parser: header edition while it has not ended, otherwise the next entry of the list. Fees are not parsed.

DNN site, /annual-meeting redirects to /annual-meeting/home. Home text 'BOFAS 2026 will be held in Wales from 4th to 6th of November'. Venue and city from /annual-meeting/venue. Fees are a PDF ('2026 Registration Rates Newport.pdf') linked from /annual-meeting/registration, read with pypdf.

Custom PHP site, /conference/2027/. Header: '...will take place on 6-8 January 2027 as a hybrid event at:' then venue, street, city, postcode. Fees on the 'Booking Details' page (index.php?contentid=N, id changes yearly; found from the nav link) as one-cell-per-line tables for full, day, social and virtual rates, three price columns (early/standard/late).

Dedicated Sitecore event site accscientificsession.acc.org. Home: 'ACC.27-WCC ... April 10 - 12, 2027 in Houston, TX'. Venue from the Travel page ('will take place at the George R. Brown Convention Center'). Fees: four <h2>+<table> packages (PLUS, in-person, @Home virtual, Expo only) on Registration Rates & Dates. Abstract state from the Late-Breaking Clinical Trials page.

ASP.NET site. Kidney Week 2026 (Denver, 21-25 Oct) landing page; year-specific sub-pages register-overview.aspx and important-dates.aspx are linked from it. Fees are <h4>program + table (Early/Standard/Onsite) blocks; Important Dates lists the date line before its label.

Sitecore. /annualmeeting shows 'Thank you for making ANESTHESIOLOGY 2026 a success' and the next edition as one pipe line: 'ANESTHESIOLOGY 2027 | October 15- 19 | Boston, MA | Thomas M. Menino Convention & Exhibition Center' (stray space in the range). Abstract schedule on /annualmeeting/education/submissions. Registration page still describes 2026.

ueg.eu/week shows the current congress (UEG Week 2026, Barcelona 17-20 Oct, just finished) and ends with a 'UEG Week 2027 / October 16 - 19, 2027 / Bella Center Copenhagen, Denmark' block for the next edition. Family finds the 2027 block; hooks add the city and keep 2026 blurbs, fee pages, CME and abstract text out of the 2027 row.

BAAPS /about/events is a calendar of many events, not one congress, so this is a bespoke extractor on the rcpath.py pattern (single_congress family does not fit). Walks /about/events/date/<YYYY>/ for this year and the next two (div.date_row cards), keeps unfinished events whose page is plastic/aesthetic-surgery related or organised by BAAPS (the calendar also carries unrelated nursing/healthcare promoter listings), then reads each detail page. Fees come from the organiser's own site JSON-LD where linked; BAAPS-booked events are behind login.

Kentico + Blazor; cards are server-prerendered. Walk /events?page=N&start=<today> (the start param is required for page 2, else the unfiltered 100-event archive is returned) until the pager total is reached. Cards give title, dd-mm-yyyy @ hh:mm range and location; event type comes from the title. Detail has a Registration fees block of 'label:' / '£amount' lines.

Eventfolio (Preside) calendar; listing comes from the public JSON endpoint /ems/eventCalendar/ajaxResults/ (offset/page_size), same card HTML. Detail pages have a structured header (.event-date/.event-venue/.event-pricing) and a Booking widget. External/Non-BOA rows are stubs; the Go-to-event-website link is kept as organiser_url. Booking pages are login-walled. 2027 Annual Congress is read from the future-congresses page.

Umbraco event-search: cards are server-rendered (default filter = upcoming); date lines have no year for this year's events (year from URL slug or next occurrence). Load-more only appears above ~96 cards. Annual events (Winter Meeting, Congress) are empty shells on escrs.org: details come from the wintermeeting/congress microsites when they name the same year. Education events (Vision to Venture) reach public EUR ticket prices via /v2v/ page -> members.escrs.org/event/. Affiliated events link to the organiser (Outlook SafeLink unwrapped).

Eventfolio (Preside) calendar, same platform as boa.ac.uk; listing from the public JSON endpoint /ems/eventCalendar/ajaxResults/ (card HTML). Detail header has .event-date/.event-time/.event-venue; fees only in the Booking widget (booking pages are login-walled). The SOA congress card is a stub: real info and image-only fee tables are on /events/soaNN.html and /events/soaNN/tickets.html (vision). On-demand rows skipped.
